description.narrative: De övergripande målen för kärnaktiviteterna är: - Bidra avsevärt till att utforma en minskning av koldioxidutsläppen, stödja omvandlingen av nyckelsektorer genom att främja innovationer och använda lämplig teknik. - Klimatpolitiken är en hög prioritet för staten, klimatåtgärder är inbäddade i all nationell politik och klimatmålen i de "nationellt fastställda bidragen" uppnås. - Rättsligt och praktiskt socioekologiskt skydd och restaurering av minst tre floder i landet och deras marknadsföring som "axlar" för lokal hållbar utveckling. - Stödja inrättandet av en effektiv mekanism för att skydda naturen, ekosystemen, djurlivet och deras livsmiljöer genom att förespråka och utbilda om bästa praxis och policyer för förvaltning och finansiering av skyddade områden. - Skapa allierade och dela kunskap med organisationer, medborgare och samhällen så att de aktivt deltar i beslutsprocesserna inom miljöområdet. - Eko-svest är en stark, stabil och professionell organisation som kontinuerligt finansieras och har fungerande mekanismer och system för ett framgångsrikt genomförande av strategin.

The overall objectives of the Core Activities are: - Contribute significantly to shaping decarbonization policies, supporting the transformation of key sectors through the promotion of innovations and deployment of appropriate technologies. - Climate policies are a high priority of the state, climate action is embedded in all national policies, and the climate goals of the "National Determined Contributions" are achieved. - Legal and practical socio-ecological protection and restoration of at least 3 rivers in the country and their promotion as "axes" of local sustainable development. - Support the establishment of an effective mechanism for the protection of nature, ecosystems, wildlife and their habitats by advocating and educating on the best practices and policies for the management and financing of protected areas. - Create allies and share knowledge with organizations, citizens and communities so that they actively participate in the decision-making processes in the field of the environment. - Eko-svest is a strong, stable and professional organization that is continuously funded and has functional mechanisms and systems for successful implementation of the Strategy.

The overall objectives of the Core Support to CSO Eko-svest 2025-2028 are:
- Contribute significantly to shaping decarbonization policies, supporting the transformation of key sectors through the promotion of innovations and deployment of appropriate technologies. - Climate policies are a high priority of the state, climate action is embedded in all national policies, and the climate goals of the "National Determined Contributions" are achieved. - Legal and practical socio-ecological protection and restoration of at least 3 rivers in the country and their promotion as "axes" of local sustainable development. - Support the establishment of an effective mechanism for the protection of nature, ecosystems, wildlife and their habitats by advocating and educating on the best practices and policies for the management and financing of protected areas. - Create allies and share knowledge with organizations, citizens and communities so that they actively participate in the decision-making processes in the field of the environment. - Eko-svest is a strong, stable and professional organization that is continuously funded and has functional mechanisms and systems for successful implementation of the Strategy.
